question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**wandering**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the challenge of maintaining focus while trying to study.
 
• The appropriate word should indicate a difficulty or distraction that affects concentration.
 
• "**Wandering**" (**आवारागर्द**) fits well as it describes thoughts that are drifting away from the task at hand, which aligns with the context of struggling to focus.
 
• Other options ("**tiring**", "**interesting**", "**worrying**") do not fit the context of describing the distraction of thoughts while trying to study.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tiring (थकाऊ):** "Tiring" means causing one to need rest or sleep.
 
• **Interesting (दिलचस्प):** "Interesting" means arousing curiosity or interest.
 
• **Worrying (चिंताजनक):** "Worrying" means causing anxiety or concern.
